text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ

translations.asad: Nun. CONSIDER the pen, and all that they write [therewith]!
translations.sahih: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe,

translations.asad: Thou art not, by thy Sustainer's grace, a madman!
translations.sahih: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

translations.asad: And, verily, thine shall be a reward neverending –
translations.sahih: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.

translations.asad: for, behold, thou keepest indeed to a sublime way of life;
translations.sahih: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

translations.asad: and [one day] thou shalt see, and they [who now deride thee] shall see,
translations.sahih: So you will see and they will see

translations.asad: which of you was bereft of reason.
translations.sahih: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

text.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ

translations.asad: Verily, thy Sustainer alone is fully aware as to who has strayed from His path, Just as He alone is fully aware of those who have found the right way.
translations.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

translations.asad: Hence, defer not to [the likes and dislikes of] those who give the lie to the truth:
translations.sahih: Then do not obey the deniers.

translations.asad: they would like thee to be soft [with them], so that they might be soft [with thee].
translations.sahih: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].

translations.asad: Furthermore, defer not to the contemptible swearer of oaths,
translations.sahih: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

translations.asad: [or to] the slanderer that goes about with defaming tales,
translations.sahih: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

translations.asad: [or] the withholder of good, [or] the sinful aggressor,
translations.sahih: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

translations.asad: [or] one who is cruel, by greed possessed, and, in addition to all this, utterly useless [to his fellow-men].
translations.sahih: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.

translations.asad: Is it because he is possessed of worldly goods and children
translations.sahih: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

text.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: that, whenever Our messages are conveyed to him, such a one says, "Fables of ancient times"?
translations.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

translations.asad: [For this] We shall brand him with indelible disgrace!
translations.sahih: We will brand him upon the snout.

text.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ

translations.asad: [As for such sinners,] behold, We [but] try them as We tried the owners of a certain garden who vowed that they would surely harvest its fruit on the morrow,
translations.sahih: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

translations.asad: and made no allowance [for the will of God]:
translations.sahih: Without making exception.

text.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ

translations.asad: whereupon a visitation for thy Sustainer came upon that [garden] while they were asleep,
translations.sahih: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.

translations.asad: so that by the morrow it became barren and bleak.
translations.sahih: And it became as though reaped.

translations.asad: Now when they rose at early morn, they called unto one another,
translations.sahih: And they called one another at morning,

text.arabic: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ

translations.asad: "Go early to your tilth if you want to harvest the fruit!"
translations.sahih: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."

translations.asad: Thus they launched forth, whispering unto one another,
translations.sahih: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

text.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ

translations.asad: "Indeed, no needy person shall enter it today [and come] upon you [unawares],"
translations.sahih: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

translations.asad: – and early they went, strongly bent upon their purpose.
translations.sahih: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.

translations.asad: But as soon as they beheld [the garden and could not recognize] it, they exclaimed, "Surely we have lost our way!"
translations.sahih: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

translations.asad: - [and then,] "Nay, but we have been rendered destitute!"
translations.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."

text.arabic: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

translations.asad: Said the most right-minded among them: "Did I not tell you, 'Will you not extol God's limitless glory?’"
translations.sahih: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

translations.asad: They answered: "Limitless in His glory is our Sustainer! Verily, we were doing wrong!"
translations.sahih: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

translations.asad: - and then they turned upon one another with mutual reproaches.
translations.sahih: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

translations.asad: [In the end] they said: "Oh, woe unto us! Verily, we did behave outrageously!
translations.sahih: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

text.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

translations.asad: [But] it may be that our Sustainer will grant us something better instead: for, verily, unto our Sustainer do we turn with hope!"
translations.sahih: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."

text.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: SUCH is the suffering [with which We try some people in this world]; but greater by far will be the suffering [which sinners shall have to bear] in the life to come - if they but knew it!
translations.sahih: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

text.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

translations.asad: For, behold, it is the God-conscious [alone] whom gardens of bliss await with their Sustainer:
translations.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

translations.asad: or should We, perchance, treat those who surrender themselves unto Us as [We would treat] those who remain lost in sin?
translations.sahih: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

translations.asad: What is amiss with you? On what do you base your judgment [of right and wrong]?
translations.sahih: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

translations.asad: Or have you, perchance, a [special] divine writ which you study,
translations.sahih: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

translations.asad: and in which you find all that you may wish to find?
translations.sahih: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

text.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

translations.asad: Or have you received a solemn promise, binding on Us till Resurrection Day, that yours will assuredly be whatever you judge [to be your rightful due]?
translations.sahih: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

translations.asad: Ask them which of them is able to vouch for this!
translations.sahih: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

text.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ

translations.asad: Or have they, perchance, any sages to support their views? Well, then, if they are sincere in this their claim, let them produce those supporters of theirs
translations.sahih: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.

text.arabic: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

translations.asad: on the Day when man's very being shall be bared to the bone, and when they [who now deny the truth] shall be called upon to prostrate themselves [before God], and shall be unable to do so:
translations.sahih: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,

text.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ

translations.asad: downcast will be their eyes, with ignominy overwhelming them - seeing that they had been called upon [in vain] to prostrate themselves [before Him] while they were yet sound [and alive].
translations.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.

text.arabic: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: Hence, leave Me alone with such as give the lie to this tiding. We shall bring them low, step by step, without their perceiving how it has come about:
translations.sahih: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.

translations.asad: for, behold, though I may give them rein for a while, My subtle scheme is exceedingly firm!
translations.sahih: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

text.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ

translations.asad: Or is it that [they fear lest] thou ask them for a reward, [O Prophet,] so that they would be burdened with debt [if they listened to thee]?
translations.sahih: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

translations.asad: Or [do they think] that the hidden reality [of all that exists] is within their grasp, so that [in time] they can write it down?
translations.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

text.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ

translations.asad: BEAR THEN with patience thy Sustainer's will and be not like him of the great fish, who cried out [in distress] after having given in to anger.
translations.sahih: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.

text.arabic: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ

translations.asad: [And remember:] had not grace from his Sustainer reached him, he would indeed have been cast forth upon that barren shore in a state of disgrace:
translations.sahih: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.

translations.asad: but [as it was,] his Sustainer had elected him and placed him among the righteous.
translations.sahih: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

text.arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

translations.asad: Hence, [be patient,] even though they who are bent on denying the truth would all but kill thee with their eyes whenever they hear this reminder, and [though] they say, "[As for Muhammad,] behold, most surely he is a madman!"
translations.sahih: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

translations.asad: [Be patient:] for this is nought else but a reminder [from God] to all mankind.
translations.sahih: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
